overview: The Council approved $2.3 million for road resurfacing and stadium turf replacement, authorized the 2026 general election, and adopted a zoning amendment for inclusionary housing fractional payments. Significant debate focused on legal department transparency and the Mayor's refusal to publicize Council neighborhood meetings.

items.title: Ward 5 Neighborhood Meeting
items.summary: Approved a resolution inviting residents to a neighborhood meeting at the Missituk Elementary School on October 20.

items.title: Condolence Resolution: Police K9 Seamus
items.summary: Approved a resolution expressing condolences to the McGillivray family and the Medford Police Department on the passing of K9 officer Seamus.

items.title: Fire Prevention Day
items.summary: Approved a resolution inviting residents to the Medford Fire Department's interactive safety event on October 10.

items.title: Meeting Records
items.summary: Approved the records of the September 15, 2026, meeting.

items.title: Resident Services Committee Report
items.summary: Approved a report detailing feedback from the Ward 1 meeting and plans for future neighborhood sessions.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance RFP Referral
items.summary: Referred a draft request for proposals for zoning updates to the Committee of the Whole for public discussion.

items.title: City Website Improvements
items.summary: Referred a resolution to modernize the city website and improve accessibility to the Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee.

items.title: Support for Encore Strike
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting striking workers at Encore Boston Harbor and urging the city to honor the picket lines.

items.title: 2026 General Election Call
items.summary: Authorized the call for the November 3, 2026, general election, detailing polling locations and early voting periods.

items.title: Election Warrant Approval
items.summary: Approved the official election warrant, including nine statewide ballot questions.

items.title: Road Resurfacing and Capital Improvements
items.summary: Approved a $1.3 million appropriation for milling and overlaying 23 city streets.

items.title: Hormel Stadium Turf Replacement
items.summary: Approved $1 million from the Capital Stabilization Fund to replace the aging artificial turf at Hormel Stadium.

items.title: Medford Connects Funding
items.summary: Approved $40,000 for the Medford Connects program to restore staff capacity lost after a state grant cycle was not renewed.

items.title: Grant of Location: North Street
items.summary: Approved a petition by National Grid and Verizon to relocate utility poles at the entrance of the Walkling Court redevelopment.

items.title: Zoning Amendment: Inclusionary Housing
items.summary: Ordained a zoning amendment allowing developers of smaller projects to make fractional payments to the Affordable Housing Trust instead of rounding up unit requirements.

items.title: Law Department Information Requests
items.summary: Tabled the response regarding litigation costs after councilors argued the data provided for $5.7 million in legal expenses lacked sufficient matter-level detail.

items.title: Law Department Supplemental Funding
items.summary: Approved one month of funding through October while requesting that the Fire Chief appear to discuss ongoing legal disputes.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meeting Publicity
items.summary: Approved a resolution objecting to the administration's refusal to publicize official council neighborhood meetings and the removal of listings from the city website.

items.title: Police Chief Search Tabled
items.summary: Tabled a $35,000 request for an executive search firm because the administration has not yet scheduled a public meeting with the consultant.

items.title: Food Truck Permit
items.summary: Approved a one-day food truck permit for Trolley Dogs at the Brooks Elementary Fall Fest on October 4.
